comment: Idle loop for the T. rex rig (scripts/blender/animate_idle.py). Seconds and bone-local XYZ degrees, conventions as in tyrannosaurus-rex-poses.json: +yaw turns toward the animal's left, -pitch raises, jaw -pitch closes. Amplitudes stay inside the range the rig test passed (docs/lookdev/tyrannosaurus-rex-rig.md).
name: Idle

breathing.comment: Rib cage widens and deepens on the inhale. spine3 takes the inverse scale so the neck, head and arms keep their size.

look.comment: Total neck + head turn, shared between bones by weight. Keys are [time, yaw, pitch], eased between.

jaw.comment: Keys are [time, pitch]: a slight closing while looking left, a slight opening on the second exhale.

tail.comment: A slow side-to-side wave that travels toward the tip (phase lag per bone), with a small lift twice per loop.
